Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

Cash and cash equivalents.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents
Cash and cash equivalents.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

Cash and cash equivalents.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
Cash and cash equivalents.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

Net cash used in investing activities.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
Net cash used in investing activities.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.
Net cash used in investing activities.metric_type: Net cash used in investing activities

Net cash used in investing activities.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities
Net cash used in investing activities.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities, including discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.
Net cash used in investing activities.metric_type: Net cash used in investing activities

Net cash used in investing activities.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
Net cash used in investing activities.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.
Net cash used in investing activities.metric_type: Net cash used in investing activities

Net cash provided by (used in) financing.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities
Net cash provided by (used in) financing.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities, including discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.
Net cash provided by (used in) financing.metric_type: Net cash provided by (used in) financing activities

Net cash provided by (used in) financing.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
Net cash provided by (used in) financing.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.
Net cash provided by (used in) financing.metric_type: Net cash provided by (used in) financing activities

Net cash provided by (used in) financing.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
Net cash provided by (used in) financing.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.
Net cash provided by (used in) financing.metric_type: Net cash provided by (used in) financing activities

Effect of exchange rate changes on cash.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect
Effect of exchange rate changes on cash.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
Effect of exchange rate changes on cash.metric_type: Effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents

Effect of exchange rate changes on cash.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
Effect of exchange rate changes on cash.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage. Excludes amount for disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
Effect of exchange rate changes on cash.metric_type: Effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents

Effect of exchange rate changes on cash.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents
Effect of exchange rate changes on cash.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
Effect of exchange rate changes on cash.metric_type: Effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents

Net increase (decrease) in cash and cash.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
Net increase (decrease) in cash and cash.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage. Excludes amount for disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
Net increase (decrease) in cash and cash.metric_type: Net increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents

Net increase (decrease) in cash and cash.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents
Net increase (decrease) in cash and cash.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
Net increase (decrease) in cash and cash.metric_type: Net increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents

Short-term investments.label: Equity Method Investments
Short-term investments.description: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

Allowance for doubtful accounts.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
Allowance for doubtful accounts.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

Allowance for doubtful accounts.label: Accounts Payable, Current
Allowance for doubtful accounts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

Cash paid for amounts included in the me.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
Cash paid for amounts included in the me.description: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.
Cash paid for amounts included in the me.metric_type: Cash paid for amounts included in the measurement of lease liabilities

Net cash paid for income taxes.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
Net cash paid for income taxes.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.
Net cash paid for income taxes.metric_type: Net cash paid for income taxes

Net cash paid for income taxes.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
Net cash paid for income taxes.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.
Net cash paid for income taxes.metric_type: Net cash paid for income taxes

Total inventories.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
Total inventories.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

Total inventories.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories and Other Operating Assets
Total inventories.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in inventory, and assets classified as other.

short-term borrowings.label: Long-term Debt
short-term borrowings.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

Total assets.label: Assets
Total assets.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

Total assets.label: Assets, Current
Total assets.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

Total assets.label: Deposits Assets
Total assets.description: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment in the future.

Ending balance at December 31, 2023.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
Ending balance at December 31, 2023.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

Ending balance at December 31, 2024.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
Ending balance at December 31, 2024.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

Cash dividends.label: Payments of Dividends
Cash dividends.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

Unrealized gain on cash flow hedges (net.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives and Commodity Contracts
Unrealized gain on cash flow hedges (net.description: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open derivatives, commodity, or energy contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.
Unrealized gain on cash flow hedges (net.metric_type: Unrealized gain on cash flow hedges (net of tax expense (benefit) of $ 0.1 in 2024 and $( 1.2 ) in 2023 )

Cash, cash equivalents and short-term in.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
Cash, cash equivalents and short-term in.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage. Excludes amount for disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
Cash, cash equivalents and short-term in.metric_type: Cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments

Cash, cash equivalents and short-term in.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents
Cash, cash equivalents and short-term in.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
Cash, cash equivalents and short-term in.metric_type: Cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments

Maturities of the term loan.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, after Year Five
Maturities of the term loan.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

Debt extinguishment expenses.label: Long-term Debt
Debt extinguishment expenses.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

Term SOFR.label: Long-term Debt
Term SOFR.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

Term SOFR.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
Term SOFR.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

Base rate.label: Lessee, Finance Lease, Discount Rate
Base rate.description: Discount rate used by lessee to determine present value of finance lease payments.

Commitment fee.label: Inventory, Firm Purchase Commitment, Loss
Commitment fee.description: Amount of loss recognized on firm purchase commitment for inventory.

Commitment fee.label: Loss from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge
Commitment fee.description: Amount of loss recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as a fair value hedge.

Original issue discount.label: Lessee, Finance Lease, Discount Rate
Original issue discount.description: Discount rate used by lessee to determine present value of finance lease payments.

Outstanding balance.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
Outstanding balance.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

Short-term debt.label: Long-term Debt
Short-term debt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

Current maturities of long-term debt.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
Current maturities of long-term debt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

Current maturities of long-term debt.label: Long-term Debt
Current maturities of long-term debt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

Additional paid-in capital.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
Additional paid-in capital.description: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

Additional paid-in capital.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
Additional paid-in capital.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

Accumulated other comprehensive loss.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
Accumulated other comprehensive loss.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

Accumulated other comprehensive loss.label: Other Income
Accumulated other comprehensive loss.description: Amount of revenue and income classified as other.

Purchases of property, plant and equipme.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
Purchases of property, plant and equipme.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.
Purchases of property, plant and equipme.metric_type: Purchases of property, plant and equipment

Purchases of property, plant and equipme.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
Purchases of property, plant and equipme.description: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.
Purchases of property, plant and equipme.metric_type: Purchases of property, plant and equipment

Purchases of property, plant and equipme.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
Purchases of property, plant and equipme.description: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.
Purchases of property, plant and equipme.metric_type: Purchases of property, plant and equipment

Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage. Excludes amount for disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash.metric_type: Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash acquired

Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents
Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash.metric_type: Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash acquired

Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.
Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash.metric_type: Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash acquired

Proceeds from sale of assets.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
Proceeds from sale of assets.description: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

Purchases of short-term investments.label: Equity Method Investments
Purchases of short-term investments.description: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

Other investing activities.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
Other investing activities.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

Other investing activities.label: Other Income
Other investing activities.description: Amount of revenue and income classified as other.

Long-term debt issuance.label: Long-term Debt
Long-term debt issuance.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

Long-term debt issuance.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
Long-term debt issuance.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

Repayment of long-term debt.label: Long-term Debt
Repayment of long-term debt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

Repayment of long-term debt.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
Repayment of long-term debt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

Repayment of short-term debt.label: Long-term Debt
Repayment of short-term debt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

Dividends paid to non-controlling intere.label: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Paid
Dividends paid to non-controlling intere.description: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited partnership (LP).

Cash dividends paid.label: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Paid
Cash dividends paid.description: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited partnership (LP).

Property, plant and equipment additions.label: Increase (Decrease) in Asset Retirement Obligations
Property, plant and equipment additions.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of asset retirement obligations.
Property, plant and equipment additions.metric_type: Property, plant and equipment additions related to asset retirement obligations

Property, plant and equipment additions.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
Property, plant and equipment additions.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.
Property, plant and equipment additions.metric_type: Property, plant and equipment additions related to asset retirement obligations

Property, plant and equipment additions.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
Property, plant and equipment additions.description: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.
Property, plant and equipment additions.metric_type: Property, plant and equipment additions related to asset retirement obligations

Excise tax charged to equity not paid.label: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments
Excise tax charged to equity not paid.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.
Excise tax charged to equity not paid.metric_type: Excise tax charged to equity not paid

Excise tax charged to equity not paid.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
Excise tax charged to equity not paid.description: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.
Excise tax charged to equity not paid.metric_type: Excise tax charged to equity not paid

Excise tax charged to equity not paid.label: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Paid
Excise tax charged to equity not paid.description: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited partnership (LP).
Excise tax charged to equity not paid.metric_type: Excise tax charged to equity not paid

Right-of-use assets obtained in the exch.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
Right-of-use assets obtained in the exch.description: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.
Right-of-use assets obtained in the exch.metric_type: Right-of-use assets obtained in the exchange for operating lease liabilities

Right-of-use assets obtained in the exch.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
Right-of-use assets obtained in the exch.description: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.
Right-of-use assets obtained in the exch.metric_type: Right-of-use assets obtained in the exchange for operating lease liabilities

Weighted-average remaining operating lea.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
Weighted-average remaining operating lea.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

Weighted-average remaining operating lea.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
Weighted-average remaining operating lea.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

Weighted-average operating leases discou.label: Lessee, Finance Lease, Discount Rate
Weighted-average operating leases discou.description: Discount rate used by lessee to determine present value of finance lease payments.

Weighted-average operating leases discou.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
Weighted-average operating leases discou.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

Right-of-use-asset.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
Right-of-use-asset.description: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

Right-of-use-asset.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
Right-of-use-asset.description: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

Lease liability - current.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
Lease liability - current.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

Lease liability - current.label: Finance Lease, Liability
Lease liability - current.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

Lease liability - current.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
Lease liability - current.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

Lease liability - non-current.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
Lease liability - non-current.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

Lease liability - non-current.label: Finance Lease, Liability
Lease liability - non-current.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

Lease liability - non-current.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
Lease liability - non-current.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

Total future minimum lease payments.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payment, Due
Total future minimum lease payments.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

Total future minimum lease payments.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
Total future minimum lease payments.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

Deferred tax assets attributable to: Net.label: Operating Income (Loss)
Deferred tax assets attributable to: Net.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.
Deferred tax assets attributable to: Net.metric_type: Deferred tax assets attributable to: Net operating loss carry forwards

Deferred tax assets attributable to: Net.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
Deferred tax assets attributable to: Net.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.
Deferred tax assets attributable to: Net.metric_type: Deferred tax assets attributable to: Net operating loss carry forwards

Accounts payable.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Accounts payable.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
Accounts payable.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

Restructuring liabilities.label: Liabilities
Restructuring liabilities.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.

Restructuring liabilities.label: Liabilities, Current
Restructuring liabilities.description: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

Income taxes payable.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
Income taxes payable.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

Prepaid expenses and other.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
Prepaid expenses and other.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

Prepaid expenses and other.label: Operating Expenses
Prepaid expenses and other.description: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

Prepaid expenses and other.label: Prepaid Expense, Current
Prepaid expenses and other.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

Operating lease cost.label: Cost of Revenue
Operating lease cost.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

Operating lease cost.label: Operating Expenses
Operating lease cost.description: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

Operating lease cost.label: Operating Income (Loss)
Operating lease cost.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

Total restructuring and other items, net.label: Accounts and Other Receivables, Net, Current
Total restructuring and other items, net.description: Amount, after allowance, receivable from customers, clients, or other third-parties, and receivables classified as other due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
Total restructuring and other items, net.metric_type: Total restructuring and other items, net

Total restructuring and other items, net.label: Other Receivables, Net, Current
Total restructuring and other items, net.description: Amount, after allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.
Total restructuring and other items, net.metric_type: Total restructuring and other items, net

Total asset write-down charges.label: Asset Impairment Charges
Total asset write-down charges.description: Amount of write-down of assets recognized in the income statement. Includes, but is not limited to, losses from tangible assets, intangible assets and goodwill.

pre-tax compensation costs.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Share-based Compensation Cost
pre-tax compensation costs.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from share-based compensation.

pre-tax compensation costs.label: Amortization of Acquisition Costs
pre-tax compensation costs.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of capitalized costs associated with acquisition of business. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

pre-tax compensation costs.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
pre-tax compensation costs.description: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

the related tax benefit.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
the related tax benefit.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

weighted average grant date fair value f.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Issued, Basic
weighted average grant date fair value f.description: This element represents the weighted average total number of shares issued throughout the period including the first (beginning balance outstanding) and last (ending balance outstanding) day of the period before considering any reductions (for instance, shares held in treasury) to arrive at the weighted average number of shares outstanding. Weighted average relates to the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares have been issued and outstanding to the total time in that period. Such concept is used in determining the weighted average number of shares outstanding for purposes of calculating earnings per share (basic).
weighted average grant date fair value f.metric_type: weighted average grant date fair value for stock options granted

weighted average grant date fair value f.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
weighted average grant date fair value f.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.
weighted average grant date fair value f.metric_type: weighted average grant date fair value for stock options granted

weighted average grant date fair value f.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Issued, Basic
weighted average grant date fair value f.description: This element represents the weighted average total number of shares issued throughout the period including the first (beginning balance outstanding) and last (ending balance outstanding) day of the period before considering any reductions (for instance, shares held in treasury) to arrive at the weighted average number of shares outstanding. Weighted average relates to the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares have been issued and outstanding to the total time in that period. Such concept is used in determining the weighted average number of shares outstanding for purposes of calculating earnings per share (basic).
weighted average grant date fair value f.metric_type: weighted average grant date fair value for stock options vested

weighted average grant date fair value f.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
weighted average grant date fair value f.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.
weighted average grant date fair value f.metric_type: weighted average grant date fair value for stock options vested

total intrinsic value of stock options e.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Purchase of Assets
total intrinsic value of stock options e.description: Value of shares of stock issued during the period as part of a transaction to acquire assets that do not qualify as a business combination.
total intrinsic value of stock options e.metric_type: total intrinsic value of stock options exercised

weighted average intrinsic value of the.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Issued, Basic
weighted average intrinsic value of the.description: This element represents the weighted average total number of shares issued throughout the period including the first (beginning balance outstanding) and last (ending balance outstanding) day of the period before considering any reductions (for instance, shares held in treasury) to arrive at the weighted average number of shares outstanding. Weighted average relates to the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares have been issued and outstanding to the total time in that period. Such concept is used in determining the weighted average number of shares outstanding for purposes of calculating earnings per share (basic).
weighted average intrinsic value of the.metric_type: weighted average intrinsic value of the options exercised

weighted average intrinsic value of the.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
weighted average intrinsic value of the.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.
weighted average intrinsic value of the.metric_type: weighted average intrinsic value of the options exercised

total unrecognized stock-based compensat.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense
total unrecognized stock-based compensat.description: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

total unrecognized stock-based compensat.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
total unrecognized stock-based compensat.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

total unrecognized stock-based compensat.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
total unrecognized stock-based compensat.description: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

Aggregate Intrinsic Value.label: Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
Aggregate Intrinsic Value.description: Amount of short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

Net income attributable to MTI.label: Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Attributable to Parent
Net income attributable to MTI.description: Carrying amount, attributable to parent, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

Net income attributable to MTI.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
Net income attributable to MTI.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

Weighted average shares outstanding.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
Weighted average shares outstanding.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

Weighted average shares outstanding.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Issued, Basic
Weighted average shares outstanding.description: This element represents the weighted average total number of shares issued throughout the period including the first (beginning balance outstanding) and last (ending balance outstanding) day of the period before considering any reductions (for instance, shares held in treasury) to arrive at the weighted average number of shares outstanding. Weighted average relates to the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares have been issued and outstanding to the total time in that period. Such concept is used in determining the weighted average number of shares outstanding for purposes of calculating earnings per share (basic).

Dilutive effect of stock options and def.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect
Dilutive effect of stock options and def.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
Dilutive effect of stock options and def.metric_type: Dilutive effect of stock options and deferred restricted stock units

Weighted average shares outstanding, adj.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Issued, Basic
Weighted average shares outstanding, adj.description: This element represents the weighted average total number of shares issued throughout the period including the first (beginning balance outstanding) and last (ending balance outstanding) day of the period before considering any reductions (for instance, shares held in treasury) to arrive at the weighted average number of shares outstanding. Weighted average relates to the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares have been issued and outstanding to the total time in that period. Such concept is used in determining the weighted average number of shares outstanding for purposes of calculating earnings per share (basic).

Weighted average shares outstanding, adj.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
Weighted average shares outstanding, adj.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

Basic earnings per share attributable to.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
Basic earnings per share attributable to.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.
Basic earnings per share attributable to.metric_type: Basic earnings per share attributable to MTI

Basic earnings per share attributable to.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
Basic earnings per share attributable to.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.
Basic earnings per share attributable to.metric_type: Basic earnings per share attributable to MTI

Diluted earnings per share attributable.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
Diluted earnings per share attributable.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.
Diluted earnings per share attributable.metric_type: Diluted earnings per share attributable to MTI

Diluted earnings per share attributable.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
Diluted earnings per share attributable.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.
Diluted earnings per share attributable.metric_type: Diluted earnings per share attributable to MTI

unrecognized stock-based compensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
unrecognized stock-based compensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

unrecognized stock-based compensation.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
unrecognized stock-based compensation.description: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unrecognized stock-based compensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense
unrecognized stock-based compensation.description: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

compensation expense amortized with resp.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense
compensation expense amortized with resp.description: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.
compensation expense amortized with resp.metric_type: compensation expense amortized with respect to all units

reversals ... related mostly to the conv.label: Conversion of Stock, Shares Converted
reversals ... related mostly to the conv.description: "The number of shares converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."
reversals ... related mostly to the conv.metric_type: reversals ... related mostly to the conversion of units for tax withholding purposes

Income (loss) from operations before inc.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
Income (loss) from operations before inc.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.
Income (loss) from operations before inc.metric_type: Income (loss) from operations before income taxes and income from affiliates and joint ventures: Domestic

Income (loss) from operations before inc.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
Income (loss) from operations before inc.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.
Income (loss) from operations before inc.metric_type: Income (loss) from operations before income taxes and income from affiliates and joint ventures: Domestic

Income (loss) from operations before inc.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
Income (loss) from operations before inc.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.
Income (loss) from operations before inc.metric_type: Income (loss) from operations before income taxes and income from affiliates and joint ventures: Foreign

Income (loss) from operations before inc.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
Income (loss) from operations before inc.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.
Income (loss) from operations before inc.metric_type: Income (loss) from operations before income taxes and income from affiliates and joint ventures: Foreign

Income (loss) from operations before inc.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
Income (loss) from operations before inc.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.
Income (loss) from operations before inc.metric_type: Income (loss) from operations before income taxes and income from affiliates and joint ventures

Income (loss) from operations before inc.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.
Income (loss) from operations before inc.metric_type: Income (loss) from operations before income taxes and income from affiliates and joint ventures

Domestic tax provision (benefit).label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
Domestic tax provision (benefit).description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

Domestic tax provision (benefit).label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
Domestic tax provision (benefit).description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

Foreign tax provision.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
Foreign tax provision.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

Foreign tax provision.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
Foreign tax provision.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

Total tax provision.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
Total tax provision.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

Total tax provision.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
Total tax provision.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

U.S. statutory rate.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
U.S. statutory rate.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

Consolidated effective tax rate.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
Consolidated effective tax rate.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

Consolidated effective tax rate.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
Consolidated effective tax rate.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

Depreciation and depletion expense.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
Depreciation and depletion expense.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

Depreciation and depletion expense.label: Depreciation
Depreciation and depletion expense.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

Net gain on sale of assets.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
Net gain on sale of assets.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.
Net gain on sale of assets.metric_type: Net gain on sale of assets

Amortization expense.label: Interest Expense, Debt, Excluding Amortization
Amortization expense.description: Represents the portion of interest incurred in the period on debt arrangements that was charged against earnings, excluding amortization of debt discount (premium) and financing costs.

Amortization expense.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amortization, Amount
Amortization expense.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible amortization.

Amortization expense.label: Amortization of Acquisition Costs
Amortization expense.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of capitalized costs associated with acquisition of business. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

Estimated amortization expense.label: Interest Expense, Debt, Excluding Amortization
Estimated amortization expense.description: Represents the portion of interest incurred in the period on debt arrangements that was charged against earnings, excluding amortization of debt discount (premium) and financing costs.

Estimated amortization expense.label: Amortization of Acquisition Costs
Estimated amortization expense.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of capitalized costs associated with acquisition of business. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

Bad debt expense.label: Interest Expense, Debt, Excluding Amortization
Bad debt expense.description: Represents the portion of interest incurred in the period on debt arrangements that was charged against earnings, excluding amortization of debt discount (premium) and financing costs.

Service cost.label: Cost of Revenue
Service cost.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

Service cost.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
Service cost.description: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

Service cost.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Share-based Compensation Cost
Service cost.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from share-based compensation.

Expected return on plan assets.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
Expected return on plan assets.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

Net periodic benefit cost.label: Cost of Revenue
Net periodic benefit cost.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

Net periodic benefit cost.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
Net periodic benefit cost.description: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

Net periodic benefit cost.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
Net periodic benefit cost.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

Post-Retirement Benefits - Net periodic.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Share-based Compensation Cost
Post-Retirement Benefits - Net periodic.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from share-based compensation.
Post-Retirement Benefits - Net periodic.metric_type: Post-Retirement Benefits - Net periodic benefit cost

Post-Retirement Benefits - Net periodic.label: Cost of Revenue
Post-Retirement Benefits - Net periodic.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.
Post-Retirement Benefits - Net periodic.metric_type: Post-Retirement Benefits - Net periodic benefit cost

Post-Retirement Benefits - Net periodic.label: Accrued Employee Benefits, Current
Post-Retirement Benefits - Net periodic.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations, excluding pension and other postretirement benefits, incurred through that date and payable for perquisites provided to employees pertaining to services received from them. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).
Post-Retirement Benefits - Net periodic.metric_type: Post-Retirement Benefits - Net periodic benefit cost

Segment income from operations.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
Segment income from operations.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

Segment income from operations.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
Segment income from operations.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

Gain on sale of assets, net.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
Gain on sale of assets, net.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.
Gain on sale of assets, net.metric_type: Gain on sale of assets, net

Gain on sale of assets, net.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
Gain on sale of assets, net.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.
Gain on sale of assets, net.metric_type: Gain on sale of assets, net

Capital Expenditures.label: Additional Paid in Capital, Common Stock
Capital Expenditures.description: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

Capital Expenditures.label: Additional Paid in Capital, Preferred Stock
Capital Expenditures.description: Value received from shareholder in nonredeemable preferred stock-related transaction in excess of par value, value contributed to entity and value received from other stock-related transaction. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred stock redeemable solely at option of issuer. Excludes common stock.

Capital Expenditures.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Other
Capital Expenditures.description: Amount of other increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC).

Consolidated net sales.label: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
Consolidated net sales.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

Consolidated income from operations.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
Consolidated income from operations.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

Consolidated income from operations.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
Consolidated income from operations.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

Net income.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
Net income.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

Diluted earnings per share.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
Diluted earnings per share.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

Diluted earnings per share.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
Diluted earnings per share.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

Cash provided from continuing operations.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
Cash provided from continuing operations.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

Cash provided from continuing operations.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
Cash provided from continuing operations.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

Cash provided from continuing operations.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Including Disposal Group and Discontinued Operations
Cash provided from continuing operations.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

Cash and cash equivalents.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Including Disposal Group and Discontinued Operations
Cash and cash equivalents.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, disposal group and discontinued operations.
